scripts.dev: npm run build -w @flowboard/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @flowboard/api" "npm run dev -w @flowboard/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowboard/shared && npm run build -w @flowboard/web && npm run typecheck -w @flowboard/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @flowboard/shared && npm run test -w @flowboard/api && npm run test -w @flowboard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @flowboard/shared && npm run typecheck -w @flowboard/api && npm run typecheck -w @flowboard/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate -w @flowboard/api && npm run db:seed -w @flowboard/api
